title: A dreamy cinematic photo of a young Japa
prompt: A dreamy cinematic photo of a young Japanese woman in her early 20s standing at a Tokyo pedestrian crossing at night, wearing an oversized pastel blazer over a graphic tee and pleated mini skirt, hair slightly wind-blown. Glowing neon signs in soft pink, cyan, and lavender bokeh blur behind her. Shot on Kodak Gold 200 film, warm glow, soft grain, dreamy lens flare streaks. Low-angle wide shot capturing both her and the vibrant signage. Whimsical, nostalgic 80s Tokyo nightlife energy.
